question: How many countries are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM economies WHERE is_country = 1
note: The table also holds 78 aggregates such as 'World'. Counting them is the wrong answer.

question: What is the capital city of Greece?
gold_sql: SELECT capital_city FROM economies WHERE name = 'Greece'

question: List all region names in alphabetical order.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM regions ORDER BY name

question: Which countries have no capital city recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM economies WHERE is_country = 1 AND capital_city IS NULL

question: What was the population of Greece in 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT o.value FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.name = 'Greece' AND o.indicator_id = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND o.year = 2020

question: How many income level groups are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income_levels

question: Which countries are classified as low income? List their names alphabetically.
gold_sql: SELECT e.name FROM economies e JOIN income_levels i ON i.income_id = e.income_id WHERE i.name = 'Low income' ORDER BY e.name

question: List the ISO3 codes of countries whose name starts with 'G', ordered by ISO3 code.
gold_sql: SELECT iso3 FROM economies WHERE is_country = 1 AND name LIKE 'G%' ORDER BY iso3

question: How many of the economies are aggregates rather than real countries?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM economies WHERE is_country = 0

question: Which indicators are in the environment topic?
gold_sql: SELECT indicator_id FROM indicators WHERE topic = 'environment' ORDER BY indicator_id

question: What was the average life expectancy across all countries in 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(o.value) FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND o.year = 2020

question: What was the average life expectancy in each region in 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT r.name, AVG(o.value) FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = e.region_id WHERE o.indicator_id = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND o.year = 2020 GROUP BY r.name

question: Which region contains the most countries?
gold_sql: SELECT r.name FROM economies e JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = e.region_id WHERE e.is_country = 1 GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, r.name LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 5 countries by GDP per capita in 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT e.name FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'NY.GDP.PCAP.CD' AND o.year = 2020 ORDER BY o.value DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many countries had a life expectancy above 80 years in 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND o.year = 2020 AND o.value > 80

question: How many countries are in each income level? Order by income level name.
gold_sql: SELECT i.name, COUNT(*) FROM economies e JOIN income_levels i ON i.income_id = e.income_id WHERE e.is_country = 1 GROUP BY i.name ORDER BY i.name

question: Which income level had the highest average internet usage in 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT i.name FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 JOIN income_levels i ON i.income_id = e.income_id WHERE o.indicator_id = 'IT.NET.USER.ZS' AND o.year = 2020 GROUP BY i.name ORDER BY AVG(o.value) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many observations does each indicator have? Order by indicator id.
gold_sql: SELECT indicator_id, COUNT(*) FROM observations GROUP BY indicator_id ORDER BY indicator_id

question: Which indicator has the fewest observations?
gold_sql: SELECT indicator_id FROM observations GROUP BY indicator_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC, indicator_id LIMIT 1
note: Kept deliberately ambiguous. The gold answer is the indicator id; naming the indicator instead identifies the same row and is scored wrong. This is the clearest live example of the limitation that gold queries encode one reading of a question.

question: What was the total population of all countries in 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.value) FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND o.year = 2020
note: Summing every row would double-count, because 'World' and 'Euro area' are rows too.

question: Which regions contain more than 30 countries?
gold_sql: SELECT r.name FROM economies e JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = e.region_id WHERE e.is_country = 1 GROUP BY r.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 30 ORDER BY r.name

question: What were the highest and lowest CO2 emissions per capita among countries in 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(o.value), MIN(o.value) FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5' AND o.year = 2020

question: For each year, how many countries have internet usage data? Order by year.
gold_sql: SELECT o.year, COUNT(*) FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'IT.NET.USER.ZS' GROUP BY o.year ORDER BY o.year

question: Which countries had unemployment above 20% in any year? List names alphabetically.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.name FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS' AND o.value > 20 ORDER BY e.name

question: Which 3 regions had the lowest average forest area percentage in 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT r.name FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = e.region_id WHERE o.indicator_id = 'AG.LND.FRST.ZS' AND o.year = 2020 GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY AVG(o.value) ASC, r.name LIMIT 3

question: Which countries have no education spending data for 2020? List names alphabetically.
gold_sql: SELECT e.name FROM economies e WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observations o WHERE o.iso3 = e.iso3 AND o.indicator_id = 'SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS' AND o.year = 2020) ORDER BY e.name
note: Missing data is an absent row, so this needs NOT EXISTS or a LEFT JOIN, not IS NULL.

question: Which country had the largest increase in life expectancy between 2000 and 2020?
gold_sql: WITH le AS (SELECT o.iso3, o.year, o.value FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND o.year IN (2000, 2020)) SELECT e.name FROM le a JOIN le b ON b.iso3 = a.iso3 AND a.year = 2000 AND b.year = 2020 JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = a.iso3 ORDER BY (b.value - a.value) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each region, which country had the highest GDP per capita in 2020? Give region and country name, ordered by region.
gold_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT r.name AS region, e.name AS country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.name ORDER BY o.value DESC) AS rn FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = e.region_id WHERE o.indicator_id = 'NY.GDP.PCAP.CD' AND o.year = 2020) SELECT region, country FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY region

question: Which countries had a lower GDP per capita in 2020 than in 2019? List alphabetically.
gold_sql: SELECT e.name FROM observations a JOIN observations b ON b.iso3 = a.iso3 AND b.indicator_id = a.indicator_id JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = a.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND a.indicator_id = 'NY.GDP.PCAP.CD' AND a.year = 2019 AND b.year = 2020 AND b.value < a.value ORDER BY e.name

question: Which countries had a life expectancy above their own region's average in 2020? List names alphabetically.
gold_sql: SELECT e.name FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE o.indicator_id = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND o.year = 2020 AND e.is_country = 1 AND o.value > (SELECT AVG(o2.value) FROM observations o2 JOIN economies e2 ON e2.iso3 = o2.iso3 WHERE e2.region_id = e.region_id AND o2.indicator_id = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND o2.year = 2020) ORDER BY e.name

question: How many countries have population data for every year from 2000 to 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.iso3 FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND o.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023 GROUP BY o.iso3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.year) = 24)

question: Which countries are in the top 10 by both GDP per capita and life expectancy in 2020? List alphabetically.
gold_sql: WITH top_gdp AS (SELECT o.iso3 FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'NY.GDP.PCAP.CD' AND o.year = 2020 ORDER BY o.value DESC LIMIT 10), top_le AS (SELECT o.iso3 FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND o.year = 2020 ORDER BY o.value DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT e.name FROM economies e WHERE e.iso3 IN (SELECT iso3 FROM top_gdp) AND e.iso3 IN (SELECT iso3 FROM top_le) ORDER BY e.name

question: Show Greece's population change from the previous year, for each year, ordered by year.
gold_sql: SELECT o.year, o.value - LAG(o.value) OVER (ORDER BY o.year) FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.name = 'Greece' AND o.indicator_id = 'SP.POP.TOTL' ORDER BY o.year
note: The first year has no previous year, so the correct answer contains a NULL, not a 0.

question: Which countries had a GDP per capita above the average across all countries in 2020? List alphabetically.
gold_sql: SELECT e.name FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'NY.GDP.PCAP.CD' AND o.year = 2020 AND o.value > (SELECT AVG(o2.value) FROM observations o2 JOIN economies e2 ON e2.iso3 = o2.iso3 WHERE e2.is_country = 1 AND o2.indicator_id = 'NY.GDP.PCAP.CD' AND o2.year = 2020) ORDER BY e.name

question: List every country with its 2020 unemployment rate, including countries that have no unemployment data, ordered by country name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.name, o.value FROM economies e LEFT JOIN observations o ON o.iso3 = e.iso3 AND o.indicator_id = 'SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS' AND o.year = 2020 WHERE e.is_country = 1 ORDER BY e.name
note: Countries without data must appear with NULL. An inner join drops them; COALESCE to 0 states something false.

question: What is the population-weighted average life expectancy across all countries in 2020?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(le.value * pop.value) / SUM(pop.value) FROM observations le JOIN observations pop ON pop.iso3 = le.iso3 AND pop.year = le.year AND pop.indicator_id = 'SP.POP.TOTL' JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = le.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND le.indicator_id = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND le.year = 2020

question: Which countries increased their forest area percentage between 2000 and 2020? List alphabetically.
gold_sql: SELECT e.name FROM observations a JOIN observations b ON b.iso3 = a.iso3 AND b.indicator_id = a.indicator_id JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = a.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND a.indicator_id = 'AG.LND.FRST.ZS' AND a.year = 2000 AND b.year = 2020 AND b.value > a.value ORDER BY e.name

question: In each region, what share of countries had internet usage above 50% in 2020? Give region name and the share, ordered by region.
gold_sql: SELECT r.name, AVG(CASE WHEN o.value > 50 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = e.region_id WHERE o.indicator_id = 'IT.NET.USER.ZS' AND o.year = 2020 GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY r.name

question: Which country had the highest CO2 per capita in each year from 2018 to 2020? Give year and country, ordered by year.
gold_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT o.year, e.name AS country, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.year ORDER BY o.value DESC) AS rn FROM observations o JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = o.iso3 WHERE e.is_country = 1 AND o.indicator_id = 'EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5' AND o.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2020) SELECT year, country FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY year

question: For Greece, how did the urban population share change between 2000 and 2020? Give the 2000 value, the 2020 value, and the difference.
gold_sql: SELECT a.value, b.value, b.value - a.value FROM observations a JOIN observations b ON b.iso3 = a.iso3 AND b.indicator_id = a.indicator_id JOIN economies e ON e.iso3 = a.iso3 WHERE e.name = 'Greece' AND a.indicator_id = 'SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS' AND a.year = 2000 AND b.year = 2020
